result_summary: Refuted: the registered bar joins three conditions with AND and the deletion condition is not met. Kill-gate (statement-level AUC of nearest-source cost, 98 own statements against 38 wergeland statements, ibm source, bar 0.9): 0.9670 with the anisotropy pre-pass off and 0.7889 with it on. The record names no pre-pass setting for the gate. Under the notebook's rule (killed only when both settings fail) the gate passes on the raw embeddings and the verdict is read on the one-sided residual with the pre-pass off; read on the default call (pre-pass on) the outcome is Killed-at-gate. Sanity check: DEF-TRANS-8 reproduced on source[0::7][:10] with the shipped default pre-pass (residual_a 0.958, closeness_a 0.322); each copied statement keeps 0.142857 = n/m of its mass on its own copy. Condition (i) met by construction: verbatim-extract closeness 0.9999 in both one-sided arms, against 0.3224 (balanced, pre-pass on) and 0.6343 (balanced, pre-pass off); a copied statement has nearest-source cost zero in any residual with the source marginal released, so this condition cannot fail for the lever. Condition (ii) met under the per-trajectory reading (mean over 14 seeds of the 5-dose Spearman): median per-document Spearman 1.0000 (pre-pass off) and 0.9643 (pre-pass on); under the pooled-points reading the same doses read 0.9492 and 0.8674, below the 0.95 bar (a perfectly ordered response reads 0.9838 there). On the same doses the shipped balanced residual reads -0.2571 and -0.8429, so it falls when foreign statements are added. Condition (iii) not met: the median |residual change| under 1 to 4 deletions is 34.1% of one insertion with the pre-pass off and 310.4% with it on, against a bar of 10%; one deletion only reads 23.1%, the same 10 documents in numerator and denominator read 43.9%. The one-sided residual does not move less under deletions than the balanced baseline on the same doses: median |change| 0.005211 against 0.005043 (pre-pass off) and 0.023256 against 0.015477 (pre-pass on). Prediction: the registered size held on (i) and (ii) and was falsified on (iii); the direction matched on (i) and (ii) and is not defined by the record on (iii), so direction_matched is false. With the pre-pass off the mean signed change under deletions is -0.7% of one insertion; the balanced residual rises under deletions (+0.00622 pre-pass off, +0.01789 pre-pass on). The per-case movement comes from the spread of the per-statement costs (0.0532) against the gap to the foreign costs (0.1197). No bar: tier means of the one-sided residual with the pre-pass off are gold 0.2829, adv1 0.3561, adv2 0.3185; Spearman against the model-graded residual is +0.4182 over the 11 documents and +0.6340 over the 98 statements. Guardrails hold: V 0/24, default-path smd, order_gap and source-conditioned outputs bit-identical before and after and equal to the saved 1.1.5 baseline, no file changed under src/ or tests/.
caveats: 1. Gate rule. The record does not say which pre-pass setting the kill-gate reads. The notebook's rule: the run is killed only when both settings read below 0.9, and the verdict is read on a setting that passes. Read on the default call alone (pre-pass on, AUC 0.7889) the outcome is Killed-at-gate. Neither reading promotes the lever. The choice between the two rules is the orchestrator's. 2. Default call. compute_source_conditioned applies the pre-pass by default. Inside that call the one-sided residual reads AUC 0.7889 against 0.9670 on raw embeddings, a deletion ratio of 310.4%, and a dose-response of -0.4786 on the one-statement document adv2-a. A DEF-TRANS-8 fix computed after the default pre-pass would read these numbers. Which pre-pass step causes the loss (mean subtraction or component removal) was not decomposed. 3. Condition (i) holds by construction: the nearest source statement of a copied statement is the statement itself, so its cost is zero up to float32 rounding. Of the three bar conditions, one could have failed and was met: (ii), under the configured reading rule. An extract that paraphrases the source was not measured; a later record for this lever needs one for condition (i) to be a test. 4. Reading rules. Three rules are the executor's because the record leaves them open: the gate over two pre-pass settings, the per-document Spearman, the foreign set. The notebook was executed more than once, so its outputs do not prove that each rule was written before the first numbers were seen. Per-document Spearman: mean over 14 seeds of the Spearman of each 5-dose trajectory; the record does not mention seeds, and with all 70 points of a document pooled the medians are 0.9492 (pre-pass off) and 0.8674 (on), below the bar. Foreign set: wergeland statements of 5 words or more with the HTML provenance comment of the fixture file removed, 38 statements; with the 6 heading fragments included the gate AUCs are 0.9260 and 0.7270. 5. Direction rule. Written in the repair round, after the readings were known: closeness above the balanced baseline for (i), median per-document Spearman above zero for (ii), no direction reading for (iii) because the record registers a size for the deletion effect and nothing else. It replaces a 100% threshold on the deletion ratio that the record does not contain. This changed direction_matched from true to false. No measured number differs between the previous execution and this one. 6. Fixture size: one source article, one foreign article on a related topic, 11 summaries of which two have 1 and 3 statements; adv2-a has no deletion dose (532 deletion cases, 616 inserted documents). The mean one-insertion effect in the denominator of condition (iii) includes adv2-a. 7. Pre-pass pool: the pre-pass arms use the pool of compute_source_conditioned(X, X, S), the call shape of the DEF-TRANS-8 reproduction. In a call with two different documents the pre-pass pools both, so the residual of one document depends on the other. 8. BLAS was limited to 1 thread for the arms; the readings are identical (np.array_equal) to the default thread count on the 12 checked documents. 9. docs/ is written by other campaign processes while executors run, so the docs/ reading is reported and is not part of the hold condition; in this execution 0 files under docs/ changed. This notebook writes only the metrics JSON.
